# Virlo API endpoints

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-reference.mjs from https://api.virlo.ai/openapi.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Base URL `https://api.virlo.ai`. Every call sends `Authorization: Bearer $VIRLO_API_KEY`.
Each entry: what it does, what it costs, the matching MCP tool, then its inputs (`*` = required, `[]` = a list, such as `["a", "b"]`).
Before calling an endpoint for the first time in a session, read its full input list in the live spec
(`https://api.virlo.ai/openapi.json`, path → method) when an input you need is not listed here.

## Search the analysed library

### `GET /v1/videos/digest`
Get top videos from the last 24-48 hours
- Cost: $0.25. MCP: `—`
- Query: `limit`

### `GET /v1/youtube/videos/digest`
Get top YouTube videos from the last 24-48 hours
- Cost: $0.25. MCP: `—`
- Query: `limit`

### `GET /v1/tiktok/videos/digest`
Get top TikTok videos from the last 24-48 hours
- Cost: $0.25. MCP: `—`
- Query: `limit`

### `GET /v1/instagram/videos/digest`
Get top Instagram videos from the last 24-48 hours
- Cost: $0.25. MCP: `—`
- Query: `limit`

### `POST /v1/search/videos`
Search videos
- Cost: $0.05 per library page of 25 (empty page free; `my_research` / `agent` scope free). MCP: `find_videos`
- Body (JSON): `scope`* (unless `cursor`) (virlo_library|my_research|agent), `cursor`, `agent_id`, `topics[]`, `looks_like`, `platforms[]` (tiktok|youtube|instagram), `posted_after`, `posted_before`, `creator_followers_min`, `creator_followers_max`, `views_min`, `views_max`, `likes_min`, `engagement_rate_min`, `engagement_rate_max`, `virality_min`, `outliers_only`, `regions[]`, `places[]`, `near[]`, `languages[]`, `creator_type` (individual|brand), `sort` (most_viral|most_views|newest|rising), `content_types[]` (video|slideshow), `page`

### `POST /v1/search/creators`
Search creators
- Cost: $0.05 per page of 25 (empty page free). MCP: `find_creators`
- Body (JSON): `scope` (virlo_library), `topics[]`, `bio_keywords`, `platforms[]` (tiktok|youtube|instagram), `creator_followers_min`, `creator_followers_max`, `creator_type` (individual|brand), `sort` (top_performing|rising|most_followers), `page`

Search the hook corpus
- Cost: $0.25. MCP: `search_hooks`
- Query: `limit`, `page`, `q`, `content_type` (video|slideshow|all), `platform` (tiktok|youtube|instagram), `category` (art_design|automotive|beauty|business_career|crafts_diy|education|entertainment|fashion|finance|fitness|food_beverage|gaming|health_wellness|home_garden|…), `hook_type`, `visual_hook_type` (text_hook|extreme_closeup|before_state|shocking_image|aesthetic_setup|person_speaking_to_camera|motion_action|crowded_scene|mystery_object|dramatic_zoom|animal_pet|product_reveal), `language`, `min_views`

### `GET /v1/hooks/library/categories`
Hook template library categories
- Cost: free. MCP: `search_hooks`

### `GET /v1/hooks/library`
Curated hook template library
- Cost: $0.10. MCP: `search_hooks`
- Query: `limit`, `page`, `category`, `psychology_tag`, `q`

## Lookups: creator, video, sound, hashtag, place (async)

### `GET /v1/satellite/creator/status/{job_id}`
Poll creator lookup status
- Cost: free. MCP: `lookup_creator`
- Path: `job_id`*

### `GET /v1/satellite/creator/{platform}/{username}`
Start a creator lookup job
- Cost: $0.50 base; add-ons: `data_intelligence` +$0.25, `trend_analysis` +$0.50, `audience_demographics` and/or `audience_geography` +$0.50 (one shared snapshot, free if a fresh one is cached); up to $1.75; refunded on failure. MCP: `lookup_creator`
- Path: `platform`* (youtube|tiktok|instagram), `username`*
- Query: `include`, `cross_links`, `max_videos`, `outlier_threshold`, `audience_demographics`, `audience_geography`, `freshness_days`, `trend_analysis`, `data_intelligence`, `context`, `slideshow_sort` (recent|popular)

### `POST /v1/satellite/creators/batch`
Batch creator lookup
- Cost: $0.50 per creator (free if looked up in the last 6 h with the same options). MCP: `lookup_creator`
- Body (JSON): `creators[]`*, `include`, `cross_links`, `max_videos`, `outlier_threshold`, `audience_demographics`, `audience_geography`, `freshness_days`

### `GET /v1/satellite/creators/batch/{batch_id}`
Poll batch lookup status
- Cost: free. MCP: `lookup_creator`
- Path: `batch_id`*

### `POST /v1/satellite/video-outlier`
Start a video outlier analysis job
- Cost: $0.50 (free for the same video within 6 h). MCP: `analyze_video`
- Body (JSON): `url`*, `platform`* (youtube|tiktok|instagram)

### `GET /v1/satellite/video-outlier/status/{job_id}`
Poll video outlier analysis status
- Cost: free. MCP: `analyze_video`
- Path: `job_id`*

### `GET /v1/satellite/sounds/status/{job_id}`
Poll sound lookup status
- Cost: free. MCP: `lookup_sound`
- Path: `job_id`*

### `GET /v1/satellite/sounds/{platform}/{music_id}`
Start a sound lookup job (TikTok or Instagram)
- Cost: $0.50 ($1.00 with trend analysis). MCP: `lookup_sound`
- Path: `platform`* (tiktok|instagram), `music_id`*
- Query: `trend_analysis`, `max_videos`

### `GET /v1/satellite/hashtags/status/{job_id}`
Poll hashtag lookup status
- Cost: free. MCP: `lookup_hashtag`
- Path: `job_id`*

### `GET /v1/satellite/hashtags/{platform}/{hashtag}`
Start a hashtag lookup job (TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube)
- Cost: $0.50 standard (up to 100 videos); `depth` deep +$0.50, full +$1.50; `trend_analysis` +$0.50 (includes the deep fetch, so trends alone are $1.00); up to $2.50 (full + trends). MCP: `lookup_hashtag`
- Path: `platform`* (tiktok|instagram|youtube), `hashtag`*
- Query: `trend_analysis`, `max_videos`, `sort` (top|recent), `depth` (standard|deep|full)

### `POST /v1/satellite/creator`
Start a creator lookup (JSON body)
- Cost: $0.50 base; add-ons: `data_intelligence` +$0.25, `trend_analysis` +$0.50, `audience_demographics` and/or `audience_geography` +$0.50 (one shared snapshot, free if a fresh one is cached); up to $1.75; refunded on failure. MCP: `lookup_creator`
- Body (JSON): `include`, `cross_links`, `max_videos`, `outlier_threshold`, `audience_demographics`, `audience_geography`, `freshness_days`, `trend_analysis`, `data_intelligence`, `context`, `slideshow_sort` (recent|popular), `platform`* (tiktok|instagram|youtube), `handle`*

### `POST /v1/satellite/hashtag`
Start a hashtag lookup (JSON body)
- Cost: $0.50 standard (up to 100 videos); `depth` deep +$0.50, full +$1.50; `trend_analysis` +$0.50 (includes the deep fetch, so trends alone are $1.00); up to $2.50 (full + trends). MCP: `lookup_hashtag`
- Body (JSON): `trend_analysis`, `max_videos`, `sort` (top|recent), `depth` (standard|deep|full), `platform`* (tiktok|instagram|youtube), `hashtag`*

### `POST /v1/satellite/sound`
Start a sound lookup (JSON body)
- Cost: $0.50 ($1.00 with trend analysis). MCP: `lookup_sound`
- Body (JSON): `trend_analysis`, `max_videos`, `platform`* (tiktok|instagram|youtube), `sound_id`*

### `POST /v1/satellite/video`
Start a video outlier analysis (JSON body)
- Cost: $0.50 (free for the same video within 6 h). MCP: `analyze_video`
- Body (JSON): `url`*, `platform`* (youtube|tiktok|instagram)

### `POST /v1/satellite/place`
Start a place lookup (TikTok places, beta)
- Cost: $0.50 per lookup started (beta). MCP: `lookup_place`
- Body (JSON): `place_id`, `poi_id`, `query`, `max_videos`

### `GET /v1/satellite/place/status/{job_id}`
Poll a place lookup (beta)
- Cost: free. MCP: `lookup_place`
- Path: `job_id`*

### `GET /v1/satellite/runs/{run_id}`

Paginated posts for a satellite run (sortable + filterable)

Paginated posts for a satellite run

## Research agents (async, can recur)

## Tracking (recurring)

### `POST /v1/tracking/creators`
Start tracking a creator
- Cost: $0.25 per check (recurring until paused). MCP: `track_creator`
- Body (JSON): `url`, `handle`, `platform`* (tiktok|youtube|instagram), `scrape_cadence` (six_hours|twelve_hours|daily|every_other_day|weekly|bi_weekly|monthly), `collection_depth` (standard|deep|full)

### `GET /v1/tracking/creators`
List tracked creators
- Cost: free. MCP: `get_tracking_data`
- Query: `page`, `limit`, `platform` (tiktok|youtube|instagram), `search`

### `GET /v1/tracking/creators/{id}`
Get tracked creator details
- Cost: free. MCP: `get_tracking_data`
- Path: `id`*

### `PATCH /v1/tracking/creators/{id}`
Update tracking settings for a creator
- Cost: free. MCP: `update_tracking_settings`
- Path: `id`*
- Body (JSON): `status` (active|paused), `scrape_cadence` (six_hours|twelve_hours|daily|every_other_day|weekly|bi_weekly|monthly)

### `DELETE /v1/tracking/creators/{id}`
Stop tracking a creator
- Cost: free. MCP: `untrack_creator`
- Path: `id`*

- Query: `start_date`, `end_date`, `limit`

## Account and balance

### `GET /v1/account/balance`
Get your credit balance
- Cost: free. MCP: `get_credit_balance`

### `POST /v1/account/top-up`
Get a checkout link to add balance
- Cost: free (returns a checkout link; nothing is charged until the user pays on it). MCP: `top_up_credits`
- Body (JSON): `amount_usd`*, `auto_top_up`, `auto_top_up_amount_usd`, `auto_top_up_when_below_usd`

### `POST /v1/account/auto-top-up`
Turn auto top-up off, or ask the owner to turn it on
- Cost: free. MCP: `set_auto_top_up`
- Body (JSON): `enabled`*, `amount_usd`, `when_below_usd`
